title: Trade-Off Jev Preference Table & Goal Schema
description: Formal schema for Aspiration Adaptation Theory (AAT) Goal Specifications and the dynamic Preference Table (T_t) in a SystemOne / Jev Markov chain.

RubricLevel.description: A single discrete aspiration / realization level on a goal's ordinal scale (0 .. L-1), analogous to Jev score criteria.

level.description: Zero-based ordinal index (0 = lowest acceptable/emergency floor, L-1 = highest aspiration level).

label.description: Short symbolic or human-readable label for the level (e.g., 'L0: Critical Risk', 'L2: Standard SLA').

description.description: Detailed rubric criterion used by the Decision Model to judge whether a candidate action or state reaches this level.

GoalDefinition.description: Definition of an incommensurable goal variable g_i in the aspiration space G = (g_1, ..., g_m).

id.description: Unique identifier for the goal variable (e.g., 'security', 'latency', 'budget').

description.description: Domain semantics of the goal and what higher levels represent.

rubric.description: Strictly ordered rubric levels from 0 to L_i - 1.

is_resource_stock.description: Optional flag (Selten 1998, Section 2.3): indicates whether this goal represents a depletable search/time/resource stock c_t.

default_aspiration.description: Optional normative cold-start aspiration level at t=0 when origin is 'cold_start_prior'.

default_survival_floor.description: Intrinsic non-negotiable survival floor a_i^{min} (defaults to 1 so catastrophic L0 violations trigger Bartleby refusal even when omitted by the caller).

GridRule.description: Grid-dependent local urgency and retreat rule (Selten 1998, Section 2.1). Maps a specific aspiration grid point or region to a local urgency order and retreat variable.

rule_id.description: Optional identifier for the local grid rule.

condition.description: Mapping of goal_id to either an exact integer level or a min/max range object defining the grid region where this rule applies.

urgency_order.description: Local strict ranking of goal_ids from most urgent to least urgent at this grid region.

retreat_goal.description: Goal ID whose aspiration level is lowered first if the current grid point is infeasible.

PreferenceTableOrigin.description: Provenance of the Preference Table: normative prior at t=0, zero-shot inferred by the model from x_0, anchored to status-quo realization, or adapted via Markov transition T_{t-1} -> T_t.

AdaptationTransition.description: Type of Selten AAT transition that produced the current Preference Table.

PreferenceTable.description: The dynamic Preference Table (T_t) representing the agent's Aspiration Scheme at Markov step t.

aspiration_levels.description: Current aspiration vector a_t mapping each goal_id to its required rubric level in {0, ..., L_i - 1}.

urgency_order.description: Strict priority permutation pi_t over all goal_ids (without ties), ordered from highest urgency (index 0) to lowest urgency (index m-1) for upward adaptation.

retreat_goal.description: Retreat variable r_t: the goal_id whose aspiration level is decremented when the current aspiration vector a_t is recognizably infeasible. Need not be the last element of urgency_order.

last_transition.description: Optional record of the adaptation rule applied in the step t-1 -> t.

adapted_goal.description: Goal ID whose aspiration level was raised or lowered during the transition into step t (null if initial or unchanged).

grid_rules.description: Optional Selten Section 2.1 grid rules mapping specific aspiration grid regions to local urgency orders and retreat variables.

resource_stock.description: Optional tracking of remaining search/decision stock c_t for goals marked with is_resource_stock.

survival_floors.description: Intrinsic per-goal survival floor vector a^{min} below which downward retreat is forbidden (Bartleby Floor). Defaults to a_i^{min} >= 1 when omitted by the caller.
